create_LMGenerateConfig: create an LMGenerateConfig dataclass to configure language model generation with model, dataset, and tokenizer sections
create_LMGenerateDatasetSection: create an LMGenerateDatasetSection dataclass to configure batch size and prefetch for LM generation datasets
configure_model_section: configure a ReferenceModelSection with name and dtype fields for the LM generation config
configure_dataset_section: configure an LMGenerateDatasetSection with batch_size and prefetch values for dataset loading
configure_tokenizer_section: configure a TokenizerSection with a tokenizer name for the LM generation config
